finding_text: Procedures for design change have not been established.

finding_text: There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy, the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications, whether or not the batch has been already distributed.

finding_text: Aseptic processing areas are deficient regarding the system for monitoring environmental conditions.
